about: Off-topic requests for scoring correct nothing on every Brain: general questions nobody's Brain is about. Kept apart from brainkit/null_requests.txt, which calibrates the bar for nothing, so a Brain is never scored on the requests that set its bar. Same rule as that file: no cooking, home, health, money, travel or coding.
